blocks.html: Loved and enjoyed as a celebration of life, Easter Sunday festivities are much anticipated by children. Robinsons Malls is ready to receive its customers after the Holy Week break and welcome them with Candyland-themed Easter activities and events. To join, simply register at the RMalls + App and get everyone excited with treats and access to Happy Easter, Hoppy Kids at Robinsons Malls.

Kids can indulge their artistic interests in the “Eggster Fun Art Painting” and create designs on eggs or learn to put together bunny ears to complement the face-painting sessions. On March 31, Robinsons Malls will hold day-long activities, including an Egg Hunt, an Easter OOTD Fashion Show Contest, and “The Best Easter Show Ever,” featuring dance and musical acts, game booths, magic shows, and storytelling that will be regaled and remembered by family and friends who visit the malls.

After enjoying specially prepared meals at a variety of restaurants, kids can catch up on the latest flicks from Robinsons Movieworld, where they can watch for free if accompanied by two paying adults. RMalls+ app is also running the “Pick an Egg, Get a Prize” promo from March 30-31, giving followers and users the chance to win exciting prizes from Movieworld and Playlab.
All these and more are happening only at Robinsons Malls on March 31, 2024
